# cabeda.medium.com

> > A collection of internet culture analysis and meme documentation, primarily sourced from Know Your Meme and Scientific American.

This site appears to aggregate content about viral trends, memes, and internet phenomena, with particular focus on TikTok trends and social media culture. The content includes meme explanations, viral video analysis, and occasional scientific/documentary content.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends
- Viral memes
- Internet culture
- Know Your Meme
- Catchphrases
- Exploitable memes
- Social media trends
- Meme explanations
- Internet slang
- Viral videos
- Image macros
- Cultural phenomena
- Online communities

- [Who Is The 'Bananas And Rice' Girl? The Viral Memes About Somali-American ICE Vi... | Know Your Meme](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/who-is-the-bananas-and-rice-girl-the-viral-memes-about-somali-american-ice-victim-nasra-ahmed-explained): Guide on Nasra Ahmed ICE detention viral meme by Phillip Hamilton

The Viral Conspiracy Theory Linking 'Labubu Dolls' To The... | Know Your Meme](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/are-labubus-demonic-the-viral-conspiracy-theory-linking-labubu-dolls-to-the-demon-pazuzu-explained): Guide on Labubu dolls demonic conspiracy theory by Phillip Hamilton

## TikTok & Social Media Trends

- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok catchphrase trend from BunnaB & YKNiece's 'Innit' song
- [How About A Nice Big Cup of Shut the Fuck Up | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/how-about-a-nice-big-cup-of-shut-the-fuck-up): WWII poster-based catchphrase meme trending on TikTok
- [Millennial Burger Place | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/millennial-burger-place): Millennial burger restaurant cliche TikTok trend & starter pack meme

## Exploitable Memes & Image Macros

- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Meme explainer: 'We Still Talk About You' exploitable image trend
- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme featuring Walter White & Jesse Pinkman
